name: spaceshooter-android
description: Android loader / wrapper for the SpaceShooter web game (Capacitor).

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug -x lint
scripts.build:android:debug:unix: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug -x lint
